name: statusline
description: Claude Code status line: user@host dir (git branch); model (effort), session tokens, context %; an aligned limit table whose Claude row shows the 5-hour (live payload only, "5h:-" without it) and 7-day rate limits with reset times, the 7-day % estimated to 0.1 with "~" (integer plus this machine's USD since it last changed, kept inside the integer's range) and the USD-per-1% rate inside the 7d parentheses (pinnable in statusline-usd-per-pct.txt, label "pin"); its · máy này (per weekday) and · máy khác rows split the 7-day % (USD of local transcript usage over the calibrated rate) and its Go row shows live OpenCode Go usage (5h/wk/mo, reset times) from the OpenCode Zen usage API, shown to 0.1 with "~" from the hand-ext estimate clamped to the API integer, with the hand-ext DS estimate as fallback; rows are padded by display width so no line starts with whitespace; one line per open main-session group (main session, its subagents and claude side sessions; only groups with a live process in Claude Code's session registry, named from it) with its Claude and Go %, aligned in columns (name, dimmed alias, padded percentages), the current group first with "▶"; then one "🔧 <skill> (main)" line for the skill most recently loaded by the main agent and one per recent subagent. The statusline:setup skill installs a stable shim in the Claude config dir that always runs the installed plugin version.
